messages: It seems like #b#p313##k in #b#m10002000##k wants to test whether I'm worthy of receiving his teachings.
#m10002000#'s #b#p313# gave me a letter to deliver to the #b#p319##k, who I should be able to find somewhere in #b#m10002070##k. He said I'd learn the rest of the details there.
In #b#m10002070##k, I met the #b#p319##k. He said he would test whether I was worthy of making the 2nd job advancement. Great! I told him I was ready for anything!
name: Finding the Instructor
